law: A telemetry hypothesis is accepted only with matched causal evidence, not one screen sample; diagnostics are not primary timing.

H1_load_parse_contention.statement: Pool-efficiency loss is caused by contention inside the workers' load/parse phase (co-tenant-independent).
reasoning: per-row run wall W1=5.666s W2=5.6563s W4=6.5547s; ratios vs W1: W2=0.9983, W4=1.1568
Rule: per-row run wall growth above the 25% P00 same-config spread supports in-run contention; a flat W2 with modest W4 growth and conserved total CPU refutes it as the dominant loss.
caveats: coarse span: decode/topology/trace/metrics are inside 'run'; the load/parse slice needs P02 hooks to separate
single matrix pass per W; co-tenant noise law (P00: 25-28% same-config spread) applies to absolute walls
attempt 2 (superseded, kept under failed_attempts/) measured a +44.5% W4 ratio in a busier window — the stretch is load-dependent, consistent with the oversubscription reading

mechanism_reading.observation: total worker run CPU is conserved across W (~180s); per-row run wall is FLAT at W2 and inflates only at W4 where peak_busy_procs=5 exceeds the cpuset — coordinator work (dispatch/commit/journal/hashing) plus 4 workers oversubscribe the CPUs, which alone predicts the W4 stretch without lock or I/O contention
mechanism_reading.consequence_for_10x: coordinator-side per-commit work is on the workers' critical resource; reduce or amortize it (P02 shared preparation, batched commits) — the cost shows up as per-row stretch, not as idle

H2_commit_backpressure.statement: Worker result_put blocks behind the coordinator's commit owning the only reader (residual backpressure motivating P04 drain).

evidence.alignment_note: design 01: result_put durations live in the streamed workerpool jsonl, never in the events riding the result they measure

reasoning: result_put: 32 puts, wall sum=1.868295s, max=1.840141s; coordinator commit: 32 commits, wall sum=4.773691s, max=0.220606s
the longest put is CPU-bound (cpu/wall=0.98 at 1.8401s, row 31) — state-bundle serialization work, not waiting on the reader; the other 31 puts sum to 0.0282s
H2_commit_backpressure.consequence: refuted_at_this_scale means the P04 bounded independent drain has no demonstrated residual to cover and stays conditional (P04 runs ONLY if measured residual backpressure demands it, per the /goal order).
